description: Keeps a procedure worked out in the conversation as a draft Skill for the connection open in the work screen. **Call it only when the user asks, after showing them the name, description and body and getting their agreement.** The draft is not used until the user checks it and presses Save in Settings > Skills and dictionaries; tell them so. To change an existing Skill, send the whole new text with a higher version. A user Skill cannot take the name of a built-in Skill. Never put API keys or passwords in the body (such drafts are refused).

body.description: Body of the procedure (Markdown, under 8,000 bytes)

description.description: When to use this procedure (up to 200 characters, e.g. Use in MX Stage to bulk update the completion date of permits under work orders)

name.description: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (e.g. permit-date-update)

overwrite.description: Not needed (a draft of the same name is replaced); kept for older clients

name: save_skill
title: Keep a Skill as a draft
